results.content: India are leading the series 2-0 after the third match was washed out

results.title: Navi Mumbai recognised as India’s cleanest city in latest Swachh Survekshan
results.content: Indore, ranked the cleanest city in the country for the past eight years, did not figure among the winners this year

results.title: Amidst simmering tensions, India-Bangladesh consular dialogue postponed
results.content: This would have been the fifth such consular dialogue and the first after the August 2024 uprising; postponement due to tensions over former PM Hasina’s plan to return to Bangladesh next month

results.title: Sukhbir Badal likely to meet Amit Shah on November 13, SAD-BJP alliance may be announced this month
results.content: SAD sources said that Mr. Badal is likely to leave for New Delhi after his rally at Raikot to meet Mr. Shah, with talks on seat sharing and finalising the alliance on the agenda

results.title: Prince William to attend Earthshot Prize awards in Mumbai on November 17
results.content: The environmental awards ceremony will bring together Sachin Tendulkar, Alia Bhatt and Rami Malek, alongside global innovators and climate leaders; the event will bring together 5,000 guests

results.title: AAP-BJP spar over dead fish in Yamuna ahead of Chhath Puja
results.content: The Delhi government had inaugurated a cruise in Yamuna at Sonia Vihar earlier this week; AAP alleged that the dead fish shows the pollution in the river

results.title: India and U.K. are turning climate ambition into action
results.content: The U.K.-India climate partnership shows what delivery can look like in practice. Both our countries recognise that the shift to cleaner growth is not separate from the pursuit of prosperity

results.title: Ambekar, Gunjan script history with boxing gold medals at Youth Olympics
results.content: Ambekar beat Ireland’s Kristen Jubani 3-2; Gunjan won 5-0 over Algeria’s Bouthaina Bensalah, becoming India’s first-ever woman to claim a boxing gold at the Youth Olympic Games

results.title: Vivaan Kapoor wins trap silver, secures India’s LA 2028 Olympic quota
results.content: Vivaan became only the fourth Indian men’s trap shooter after the legendary Karni Singh (silver), Manavjit Singh Sandhu (gold) and Zorawar Singh Sandhu (bronze in 2025) to win a medal at the World Championships in the highly competitive discipline

results.title: In a dilemma: On Sheikh Hasina and India-Bangladesh ties
results.content: India must improve ties with Bangladesh, and protect Hasina
